scope: 390 by 844 CSS pixel resting screenshot; visible first viewport only

context.task: Find late orders and act on them
context.fixture: Five visible shipments and three totals

quietHierarchy.reason: The content is orderly, but the large filled Export report control and heading lead the initial view while shipment delay status is absent from the visible table.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — header, export control and table columns
quietHierarchy.tradeoff: Export may be frequent; its actual frequency is unknown.
quietHierarchy.nextChange: Prioritize a visible late-status field or filter beside order identity; consider quieter export treatment only after confirming task priority.
quietHierarchy.preserve: Visible totals and clear shipment identity

surfaceRestraint.reason: One bounded table and restrained row dividers express grouping without a separate floating card around every shipment.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — table shell and row dividers
surfaceRestraint.tradeoff: Removing more dividers could weaken exact row comparison.
surfaceRestraint.nextChange: No containment change is justified by this still; retain the table boundary.

typography.reason: Clearly distinct heading, section label, column labels and data roles create readable hierarchy at the displayed size; heading wraps coherently.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — heading, table header and body
typography.tradeoff: Actual font size and contrast were not measured, and text growth was not exercised.
typography.nextChange: Verify the same hierarchy with enlarged text before changing type scale.
typography.preserve: Readable destination labels and strong section label

densityRhythm.reason: Five aligned rows and closely grouped metrics give useful scanning density; spacing separates summary from detail.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — summary metrics and five shipment rows
densityRhythm.tradeoff: The blank lower viewport alone does not prove wasted space; adding decorative panels would not help.
densityRhythm.nextChange: Recheck grouping with a longer queue and long destination names; do not fill empty space merely for appearance.
densityRhythm.preserve: Compact row comparison and breathing room around major groups

componentPrecision.reason: The table, metric rules and restrained corner treatment appear related and aligned in the visible state.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — metric rules, table frame and export control
componentPrecision.tradeoff: One still cannot establish focus, selected and error-state coherence.
componentPrecision.nextChange: Inspect focus and selected-row states in the browser before assigning a refined-state rating.
componentPrecision.preserve: Consistent dividers and aligned column headings

purposefulColor.reason: A quiet pale base and dark green accent provide a restrained working palette; no competing decorative gradients appear.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — background, metric rules and export button
purposefulColor.tradeoff: Shipment state colors are not visible, so the state palette remains unreviewed outside this scope.
purposefulColor.nextChange: When exposing delay state, retain a textual status label and use color semantically.
purposefulColor.preserve: Restrained warm palette and readable-looking data

productCharacter.reason: Dispatch vocabulary, carrier names, East Coast scope and update timing ground the neutral interface in operational work.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — eyebrow, table contents and footer
productCharacter.tradeoff: Brand ownership cannot be established from this fixture.
productCharacter.nextChange: No added illustration or logo novelty is justified; retain concrete domain language.

task.reason: Delay status is not in the visible columns, but hidden columns, filtering and task completion were not tested. This is a specific priority concern, not proof that the whole task is impossible.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — Order, Destination and Carrier are the visible columns

legibility.reason: The still supports visual inspection, but actual text/state contrast and applicable accessibility checks were not measured.
evidence: assets/examples/dashboard-phone.png — screenshot only; no computed styles

interaction.reason: Keyboard, focus, horizontal scrolling, filtering and assignment were not exercised.
evidence: No behavioral evidence in this scoped review

adaptation.reason: Only one viewport and resting fixture were inspected; text growth and other widths are untested.
